# betterado_security_namespace_token (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identifiers` (Map of String) Map of identifiers required for token generation (e.g., project_id, repository_id)
- `namespace_id` (String) The ID of the security namespace
- `namespace_name` (String) The name of the security namespace (e.g., 'Git Repositories', 'Project')
- `return_identifier_info` (Boolean) When true, returns the required and optional identifiers for the namespace instead of generating a token
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `optional_identifiers` (List of String) List of optional identifiers for this namespace (only populated when return_identifier_info is true)
- `required_identifiers` (List of String) List of required identifiers for this namespace (only populated when return_identifier_info is true)
- `token` (String) The generated security token for the namespace
